## What this region is

The @inixiative/prisma-map library, which extracts a runtime PrismaMap (models, fields, field kinds, relation FK direction, DB names, enum values, defaults, annotations) from a generated Prisma 6 or 7 client, and the template's schema-introspection helpers built on its generated map: model-name conversion, field and relation metadata, hydration, raw-SQL column aliasing and polymorphic target reading.

## What it exists for

- Convert or check a Prisma model name
- Read a model's field and relation metadata
- Name tables, columns and enum values in raw SQL
- Build a Prisma schema map

## When this is not your domain

These mention this region's words but belong elsewhere; the answer is no, and the region named answers instead.

- Make these writes behave correctly around a transaction → database-client
- Declare or read which kinds a model can point at → data-modeling
- Get my schema change into the database → database-tooling
- Which permission engine call do I use → lib-permissions
- Who is allowed to hit this endpoint → permissions-roles
